title: What Is a Rhythmic Pattern? — The Prose Path
skills: identify recurring rhythmic patterns in language
analyze how rhythm shapes pacing and emphasis
recognize patterns created by stressed and unstressed syllables
explain how rhythmic choices contribute to tone and meaning
alignment_note: Explores rhythmic patterns in language and how recurring patterns of stress, pacing, and sound influence the flow and effect of poetry and prose. Supports prosody, close reading, oral interpretation, and analysis of sound and structure across high school English courses.
